subject: Request: Promotional credit + trial extension — routing and accounting
messages:
From: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@thermowave.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@thermowave.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: promotional credit + 6-week trial extension

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the engineering team is close to greenlighting a short pilot expansion but we ran slightly over the original pilot window because of onboarding delays on our side. Can Redwood provide a modest promotional credit and extend the trial window by 6 weeks so we can finish a final E2E test before committing?

Numbers: estimated additional consumption ~ $48,500 over the extended period. Procurement needs either a credit memo or a documented invoice offset in order to reflect it in our FY28 Q2 close. I attached our PO for reference.

Can you advise next steps and what finance evidence you need? We’d like to close this before May 25 if possible.

Appreciate it,
Alex Guerrero
Head of Cloud Ops, ThermoWave
alex.guerrero@thermowave.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: ThermoWave_PO_7891.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@thermowave.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@thermowave.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: promotional credit + 6-week trial extension

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the PO. I’ve looped in Marcus from Finance to confirm what form of credit will work for your accounting team. Two quick notes up front:

- We can issue either a credit memo to be applied to the next invoice or a one-time invoice offset depending on your procurement preference.
- If you need documentation for audit, we’ll include a credit memo PDF and a short accounting note describing the offset treatment.

Marcus — can you confirm which route we should take for a $48.5k promotional allowance tied to a pilot extension, and whether we should map this to a contra-revenue allowance or a separate promotional expense account? Also looping Grace from Sales Ops for approval routing.

Alex — we’ll aim to have confirmation and a draft credit memo by EOD tomorrow (5/18).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

(Please note: I work across sales and partner billing approvals; final accounting classification sits with Finance.)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@thermowave.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: promotional credit + 6-week trial extension

FW: routing for $48,500 promotional allowance requested by ThermoWave.

Quick summary for routing/ledger treatment: 
- Approval: I authorize a promotional credit memo up to $48,500 tied to the pilot extension; this is within our promotional allowance authority for AE-managed pilots.
- Accounting treatment: Post to contra-revenue (GL 4201) as a promotional allowance. We should not book as refund (cash out). For revenue recognition transparency, include the original pilot invoice IDs in the memo.
- Invoice handling: Preferred option (customer indicated) is to issue a credit memo which ThermoWave will apply against the upcoming net invoice. If they prefer, we can also net it against an outstanding invoice — provide invoice number.
- Documentation required: signed PO (attached), internal approval email chain (this thread), and the credit memo PDF.

Laura — please prepare the credit memo PDF and include a short note for the ledger entry referencing DEAL-4823 and the pilot extension justification. Grace — confirm if AE-side discount budget consumes the allowance or if this is an overage credit from a promo bucket.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@thermowave.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: promotional credit + 6-week trial extension

Thanks — I’ve drafted the credit memo and the accompanying ledger note. Key items included:
- Credit memo id: TW-CR-4823
- Amount: $48,500.00 USD
- Applies to: Pilot period extension (original invoice reference: INV-20280501-TW, if ThermoWave will apply to that invoice); otherwise it will sit as an unapplied credit to be consumed on next invoice.
- GL coding: 4201 - Promotional Allowances (contra-revenue).
- Memo text: “Promotional credit issued for pilot extension per AE request; supporting PO attached. Apply as offset to upcoming invoice or to INV-20280501-TW upon customer request.”

I’ve attached the PDF and added an internal comment for month-end close to ensure Revenue Ops reviews allocation. If everything looks good I’ll route to Legal for signature (if required) and then upload to DocuSign link.

Attachment: TW-CR-4823-credit-memo.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Accounting Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@thermowave.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@thermowave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: promotional credit + 6-week trial extension — approved and credit memo attached

Alex / Priya — good news: Finance has approved the promotional allowance and the credit memo is attached. Quick checklist and next steps:

- Attached: TW-CR-4823-credit-memo.pdf (credit memo for $48,500) and we have your PO on file (ThermoWave_PO_7891.pdf).
- Accounting: This will post to contra-revenue (GL 4201) as a promotional allowance per Finance guidance.
- Application: Please confirm whether you would like this applied to INV-20280501-TW (recommended) or left as an unapplied credit to offset the next invoice. If you don’t respond by EOD 2028-05-22 we’ll leave it unapplied to be consumed on the next billing cycle.
- DocuSign: If you prefer a signed copy, here’s the link: https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123 (DocuSign).
- Timing: If applied to INV-20280501-TW we can reflect the offset in your account before month-end close.

Let me know your preference and I’ll follow up with the final PDF signed and the HubSpot record updated (HUBSPOT-4823).

Thanks — excited to help ThermoWave finish the evaluation window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

Attachments: TW-CR-4823-credit-memo.pdf (pdf), ThermoWave_PO_7891.pdf (pdf)
